architecture_decisions: The two-phase production-QA repository cutover has been completed.
work_items: The two-phase production-QA repository cutover has been completed.
validations: The two-phase production-QA repository cutover has been completed.

AC-01: validate protected requirement — A valid signed GitHub Actions identity for `Ryan9876/parallax-qa`, repository ID `1351817336`, exact production replay workflow, main ref, GitHub-hosted runner, admitted event, correct audience, and bounded run ID authenticates to the existing QA principal.

AC-02: validate protected requirement — A token for `Ryan9876/parallax`, repository ID `1340272514`, and `qa-production-replay.yml@refs/heads/main` is rejected after contraction even when all other signed claim guards are valid.

AC-03: validate protected requirement — A token for `Ryan9876/parallax`, repository ID `1340272514`, and `w8-s2-qa-replay.yml@refs/heads/main` is rejected after contraction even when all other signed claim guards are valid.

AC-04: validate protected requirement — The server-owned trusted workflow identity set contains only the dedicated `parallax-qa` tuple and continues to reject repository-name/ID/workflow cross-pair substitutions.
AC-05: validate protected requirement — The two retired application-repository workflow files are absent from the release tree; reusable non-authoritative harness scripts may remain.

AC-06: validate protected requirement — Wrong audience, signature or standard claims, ref, runner environment, event, workflow, repository identity, repository ID, or missing/bounded-invalid run ID remains rejected.

AC-07: validate protected requirement — Successful dedicated QA authentication still maps only to the existing bounded QA principal and does not add source publication, Git mutation, deployment, promotion, lifecycle-transition, or REVIEW-completion authority.
AC-08: validate protected requirement — `ARCHITECTURE.md` v3.31 records that staged dual trust is complete and only the exact dedicated repository tuple remains standing production-QA trust.

AC-09: validate protected requirement — Exact-head API/contracts, focused QA identity tests, Bounded Autonomy, protected promotion, Workstream Spec Validation, and committed DSPy plan validation pass before merge; promotion-boundary DSPy compilation remains required on main.

AC-10: validate protected requirement — After exact-source deployment is READY, the dedicated `Ryan9876/parallax-qa` production replay authenticates successfully and both routine source-only jobs reach REVIEW with verified authenticated source handoff. The retired application workflows are not reintroduced merely for production testing.
risks: No material risk and mitigation is required.
